pictures.scene: Carl Bloch, A Young girl knocking at the fisherman's window - a child come in from the dark to knock at a lit window for shelter, taking refuge in the LORD and asking never to be put to shame
pictures.name: pd_bloch_girl_at_fishermans_window

pictures.scene: Jan Victors, Hanna, moeder van Samuel, biddend in de tempel - Hannah kneeling in the temple with her hands open in petition, asking God in His justice to incline His ear and save
pictures.name: pd_victors_hanna_biddend_in_de_tempel

pictures.scene: Guillam Dubois, Berglandschap - a great standing rock above a wooded valley, the rock of refuge where the psalmist can always go
pictures.name: pd_dubois_berglandschap

pictures.scene: Markus Pernhart, Hochosterwitz - a walled fortress set on its own crag above the plain, God commanded to save because He is rock and fortress
pictures.name: pd_pernhart_burg_hochosterwitz

pictures.scene: Sebastiaen Vrancx, Soldaten plunderen een boerderij - armed men breaking into a farmstead and carrying off what they find, deliverance sought from the hand of the wicked and the grasp of the ruthless
pictures.name: pd_vrancx_soldaten_plunderen_een_boerderij

pictures.scene: Giuseppe Canella, Chioggia vor Sonnenaufgang - the harbour quiet in the pale light before the sun comes up, the LORD as hope and as confidence from youth
pictures.name: pd_canella_chioggia_vor_sonnenaufgang

pictures.scene: Albert Neuhuys, Moeder en kind - a mother bent over the small child in her lap in a dim cottage, leaning on God since birth and pulled from the mother's womb
pictures.name: pd_neuhuys_moeder_en_kind

pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, They Did Not Expect Him - a gaunt man walking in at the door while the whole household turns and stares, praise always for God though the psalmist has become a portent to many
pictures.name: pd_repin_zij_verwachtten_hem_niet

pictures.scene: Jan Weissenbruch, De kerk van St Denis te Luik - the heavy old church tower standing above the street, God the strong refuge and the mouth filled with His praise
pictures.name: pd_weissenbruch_kerk_van_st_denis_te_luik

pictures.scene: Anna Ancher, Solskin i den blindes stue - a blind old woman sitting in the sunlight that fills her small room, His splendor all day long and the plea not to be discarded in old age
pictures.name: pd_ancher_solskin_i_den_blindes_stue

pictures.scene: Daniel Ridgway Knight, She Has Lost Her Way - a girl stopped alone at the edge of the field with no one to turn to, strength failing and enemies speaking against him
pictures.name: pd_ridgway_knight_she_has_lost_her_way

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, The Conspiracy of Claudius Civilis - men leaning in over a table at night to swear an oath together, those who lie in wait for his life conspiring and saying God has forsaken him
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_de_samenzwering_van_claudius_civilis

pictures.scene: Wojciech Kossak, Szwolezer na zwiadach - a light cavalryman riding out on reconnaissance with his lance, the cry to pursue him and seize him for there is no one to rescue him
pictures.name: pd_kossak_szwolezer_na_zwiadach

pictures.scene: Ivan Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness - Christ sitting alone among the stones at daybreak with His hands clasped, the prayer be not far from me, hurry to help me
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christus_in_de_woestijn

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, Christ before the High Priest - the accusers pressing their charge across the candlelit table while Christ stands silent, the accusers of his soul put to shame and consumed
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_christus_voor_de_hogepriester

pictures.scene: Adolphe Yvon, Marshal Ney at the Retreat from Russia - an army broken and trudging back through the snow, those who sought his harm covered with scorn and disgrace
pictures.name: pd_yvon_ney_op_de_terugtocht_uit_rusland

pictures.scene: George Clausen, Girl in a Field - a girl standing in the long grass looking up into the light, always hoping and praising Him more and more
pictures.name: pd_clausen_girl_in_a_field

pictures.scene: Adolph Tidemand, Haugianerne - a young lay preacher standing with his open book under a shaft of light while the cottage listens, his mouth declaring God's righteousness and salvation all day long
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_haugianerne

pictures.scene: Peder Balke, Stormy Sea - a wave breaking out of a grey immensity that no one could measure, coming in the strength of the Lord GOD
pictures.name: pd_balke_stormachtige_zee

pictures.scene: Albert Anker, Das Schulexamen - the village children standing to be examined before the school and the elders, taught by God from youth and proclaiming His righteousness alone
pictures.name: pd_anker_das_schulexamen

pictures.scene: Jan Lievens, Bearded Man with a Beret - an old man with a white beard turned into the light, still proclaiming His marvelous deeds even when old and gray
pictures.name: pd_lievens_bebaarde_man_met_baret

pictures.scene: Franz von Defregger, Besuch - the grandfather at his bench with the young ones come to visit him, asking not to be forsaken until he proclaims God's power to the next generation
pictures.name: pd_defregger_besuch

pictures.scene: Francis Danby, The Avon Gorge at Sunset - the gorge opening out under a sky burning to its height, His might to all who are to come and His righteousness reaching to the heavens
pictures.name: pd_danby_avon_gorge_at_sunset

pictures.scene: Bernardo Bellotto, View of Vienna from the Belvedere - a whole city laid out in order, spires and palaces to the horizon, You who have done great things, who is like You
pictures.name: pd_bellotto_wien_vom_belvedere

pictures.scene: Gerbrand van den Eeckhout, Elisa en de Sunamitische vrouw - the prophet meeting the woman whose only son would be given back to her alive, many troubles shown and yet revived once again
pictures.name: pd_eeckhout_elisa_en_de_sunamitische_vrouw

pictures.scene: Constantin Meunier, Miner at the Exit of the Shaft - a miner climbing up out of the pit into the daylight, brought back up from the depths of the earth
pictures.name: pd_meunier_mijnwerker_bij_de_schachtuitgang

pictures.scene: Floris van Schooten, Een Hollands ontbijt - a table set out with bread, cheese and a full glass, honor increased and comfort given once again
pictures.name: pd_van_schooten_een_hollands_ontbijt

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Musicerende engelen - angels on the gold ground playing a psaltery and a tromba marina, praising Him with the harp for His faithfulness
pictures.name: pd_memling_musicerende_engelen

pictures.scene: Cornelis Dusart, Straatmuzikanten bij de herberg - village players making music together outside the inn door, singing praise to Him with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel
pictures.name: pd_dusart_straatmuzikanten_bij_de_herberg

pictures.scene: Hans Thoma, Kinderreigen - children singing in a ring as they dance through a flowering meadow above the river, lips shouting for joy when he sings praise
pictures.name: pd_thoma_kinderreigen

pictures.scene: Jacob Maris, Jaagpad - a man riding his horse home along the towpath by the still water, his soul also, which God has redeemed
pictures.name: pd_maris_jaagpad

pictures.scene: Quirijn van Brekelenkam, De voorlezer - a man reading aloud from the book to the household gathered round him, his tongue proclaiming God's righteousness all day long
pictures.name: pd_brekelenkam_de_voorlezer

pictures.scene: January Suchodolski, Bitwa pod Tudela - the attacking line breaking and giving way across the field, those who sought his harm disgraced and confounded
pictures.name: pd_suchodolski_bitwa_pod_tudela

lines: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge;
let me never be put to shame.
In Your justice, rescue and deliver me;
incline Your ear and save me.
Be my rock of refuge,
where I can always go.
Give the command to save me,
for You are my rock and my fortress.
Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked,
from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
For You are my hope, O Lord GOD,
my confidence from my youth.
I have leaned on You since birth;
You pulled me from my mother’s womb.
My praise is always for You.
I have become a portent to many,
but You are my strong refuge.
My mouth is filled with Your praise
and with Your splendor all day long.
Do not discard me in my old age;
do not forsake me when my strength fails.
For my enemies speak against me,
and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
saying, “God has forsaken him;
pursue him and seize him,
for there is no one to rescue him.”
Be not far from me, O God.
Hurry, O my God, to help me.
May the accusers of my soul
be ashamed and consumed;
may those who seek my harm
be covered with scorn and disgrace.
But I will always hope
and will praise You more and more.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness
and Your salvation all day long,
though I cannot know their full measure.
I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD;
I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
O God, You have taught me from my youth,
and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
Even when I am old and gray,
do not forsake me, O God,
until I proclaim Your power to the next generation,
Your might to all who are to come.
Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God,
You who have done great things.
Who, O God, is like You?
Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes,
You will revive me once again.
Even from the depths of the earth
You will bring me back up.
You will increase my honor
and comfort me once again.
So I will praise You with the harp
for Your faithfulness, O my God;
I will sing praise to You with the lyre,
O Holy One of Israel.
When I sing praise to You
my lips will shout for joy,
along with my soul,
which You have redeemed.
My tongue will indeed proclaim
Your righteousness all day long,
for those who seek my harm
are disgraced and confounded.
